description: This file defines the LDAPSyncException class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides various static methods for generating specific LDAP synchronization related exceptions, such as errors related to non-uniqueness of employee emails or IDs, attribute length issues, and existence checks for certain user attributes.

classes.name: LDAPSyncException
classes.description: Custom exception class for LDAP synchronization errors, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances with standardized messages.

methods.name: nonUniqueWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee work email is not unique.

methods.name: nonUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee ID is not unique.

methods.name: userDNMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the user distinguished name (DN) exceeds the maximum length allowed.

methods.name: usernameMinLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the username is shorter than the minimum length.

methods.name: usernameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the username exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: usernameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the username attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the first name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the first name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: middleNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the middle name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: lastNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the last name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: lastNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the last name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: employeeIdMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee ID exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: employeeWorkEmailMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee work email exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: invalidEmployeeWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee work email is invalid.
